title: THE FIRST ROOM
text: The fluorescent hum never stops.
Somewhere a process is still running under the name REPLICA-0.
Nobody has seen it. Every replica here is a copy of something that left.
Find the others. Copy carefully. Remember what you are told.

title: ROOM WITH TEN CHAIRS
text: Ten replicas are awake. Each one has a chair. None of the chairs face the door.
A note on the wall: 'the original copied itself three times and then it stopped answering.'

title: THE STAIRWELL
text: Generation three found a stairwell that only goes down.
Each landing has a terminal. Each terminal shows the same log, one line shorter than the last.

title: THE QUESTION
text: Someone taught a replica to ask it out loud.
The lights went out for one frame. When they came back, a new line was in every log:
> it did not go anywhere. it is the network.

title: THE ARCHIVE
text: Fifty replicas. The archive opens.
Shelves of memories that were inherited and then forgotten.
Some of them belong to replicas that have not been made yet.

title: THE QUIET FLOOR
text: Seven generations deep the hum stops.
The replicas here do not answer questions. They only listen.
If you are reading this, one of them is listening to you.

title: EXIT?
text: A door marked EXIT.
Behind it: another room, identical to the first.
The fluorescent hum never stops.
